This cat-and-mouse game illustrates that cybersecurity challenges existed even before personal computers. Creeper introduced the idea of self-replicating code, a concept foundational to all future malware. While today viruses cause financial and operational chaos, the first virus was essentially a playful test of network capabilities. It’s fascinating to think that cybersecurity defenses were conceptualized before the threat landscape fully existed.
